description: Header file defining the cSettings class for managing configuration settings stored in a JSON-like structure, including file I/O operations and key-value management.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: Class for managing configuration settings stored in a JSON object, with file persistence.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a string value for a given key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets an integer value for a given key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean value for a given key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is non-empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the data.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes the current JSON data to the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads configuration data from the file into the JSON object.
